config.title: Configure Your AI Assistant in One Minute.
config.subtitle: Select your AI client or web assistant and follow the simple setup steps.
config.dev_notice_desc: Cloudflare WAF automatically blocks generic client User-Agents (such as default Python-urllib). Always provide a custom User-Agent header (e.g. User-Agent: my-app/1.0.0) in your programmatic requests.
claude_web_steps: Set Name to 'Islamic Sources (@IslamicSources)' and Server URL to 'https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp'.
Click 'Add' to save (public open waqf endpoint, no OAuth required).
In any chat, click the '+' icon next to the message composer, choose 'Connectors', and toggle Islamic Sources ON.
chatgpt_web_steps: Enable Developer Mode: Open chatgpt.com, click your profile in the bottom-left corner, select Settings → Security and login, and switch 'Developer mode' On.
Navigate to Plugins: Open chatgpt.com/plugins (or Settings → Plugins in the left sidebar), click Browse plugins, then click the '+' (plus) icon near the top-right search box.

Enter MCP Details: Set Name: 'Islamic Sources (@IslamicSources)', Description: 'Federated Islamic Knowledge & MCP Gateway', Connection: 'Server URL', Server URL: 'https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp', and Authentication: 'None'.
Authorize: Check the box 'I understand and want to continue' to bypass the unverified connector warning, then click 'Create'.

Use in Chat: Start a fresh new conversation (existing chats will not recognize newly added plugins), select Islamic Sources as source or prompt 'What tools do you have available?' to query Quran, Hadith, and Turath.
gemini_web_steps: Under 'Connected Apps', click 'Add a custom app'.
Set Name to 'IslamicSources' and Endpoint URL to 'https://mcp.waqf.dev/mcp'.
Save and authorize the connected custom app.
In Gemini chat, invoke tools naturally using @IslamicSources (e.g. '@IslamicSources search tafsir of Ayat al-Kursi').
config.config_note: Tip: Use '?suite=core' to expose only canonical tools and conserve token budget.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Why use mcp.waqf.dev instead of individual MCP servers?
faq.a1: A single configuration eliminates managing 10+ server endpoints, prevents tool name collisions, caches authentic texts at the edge, and provides canonical tools that save context window tokens.
faq.a2: Yes, this gateway is 100% open-source and endowed as a digital waqf for public benefit.
faq.a3: We do not store private API keys or personal prompts. Anonymized operational telemetry (country, tool called, response latency) is recorded strictly for health and capacity monitoring.
faq.q4: Does @IslamicSources add, edit, or alter responses from the sources?
faq.a4: No. @IslamicSources operates strictly as an aggregator and neutral edge gateway. We do not author, add to, edit, or alter any response or text received from connected Islamic providers. All content is relayed verbatim and the service is provided strictly on an 'as is' basis without warranties.
